name: Detail Boost
description: Cuts lag in heavy, effect-filled levels without removing any object.

reduce-particles.name: Reduce particles
reduce-particles.description: Caps how many particles big particle effects can spawn. Blocks, saws, decorations and triggers are NOT touched.

particle-percent.name: Particle amount (%)
particle-percent.description: How many particles big effects may keep. 100 = vanilla, 0 = no new particles from big effects.

only-in-level.name: Only inside levels
only-in-level.description: Leave menu / icon-kit particles alone and only reduce them while playing a level.

disable-shake.name: Disable camera shake
disable-shake.description: Ignores shake triggers. Saves a little work and keeps frame times steadier.
